notes: Semtech's SRV05-4.TCT replaced ProTek's SRV05-4-P-T7 (C85364) on 2026-10-07: JLC had 2 left. Same pinout (1, 3, 4, 6 I/O; 2 REF1 = ground; 5 REF2 = positive reference) and the same JLC library footprint (SOT-23-6_L2.9-W1.6-P0.95-LS2.8-BR) as C85364, so the CPL rotation is unchanged. Plain Extended at JLC (C85364 was Preferred): one more setup fee.
Repo datasheets/SOURCES.md now points at this Semtech PDF (it used to cite onsemi's SRV05-4).

REF tied to +3V3 rather than VBUS (a deliberate design choice). Semtech p5, connection option 1: 'connect pin 5 directly to the positive supply rail (VCC)'; the data lines are then referenced to that supply.
Package: p11 outline (mistitled 'SO-8'; the dimensions are SOT-23-6): body 2.80-3.00 x 1.50-1.75 mm, e 0.95 mm, e1 1.90 mm, E 2.80 mm BSC; fits Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-23-6. Marking V05 (p12).
